title: Une curieuse égalité entre deux sommes de produits de coefficients binomiaux
summary: We will show in this text that, for all non-negative integers $n$ and $l$, the following equality is verified: \[\sum_{i=0}^{l} {n-i \choose i}{l+i \choose 2i+1}=\sum_{i=0}^{l} {n-i \choose i-1}{l+i \choose 2i}.\] We will first address the case where $l \leq n$, for which both sums contain only classical binomial coefficients. Then, we will consider the general framework using generalized binomial coefficients.
